_how: One graphic per shot at most, only where it says something: an OBJECT of the story's world that explains the line (the joke is in the object). Draw it in code (klaudia_graphics.py), never ask an image model for letters. Pick the type from what the line says. Words on it: 1–4 per row, true to the news, in CAPITALS; never a real logo, a coin, a price tip or a call to buy.

by_format.news: TV news: headline, alert, counter, meter, chart, clock. The frame adds the KLAUDIA'S NEWS bug, LIVE and the BREAKING band.
by_format.clip: music video: few graphics (2–3 in a whole video): stamp, tag, ticket as props of her world.
by_format.ad: unpaid ad: tag (price), ticket (what you get), stamp (UNPAID), meter (satisfaction 100%).

pick.line_is: a number, an audience, a count
a chance, a level, a percentage
a list of things, what something costs or contains
a verdict, an approval, a rejection
the news arriving, a message, a notification
